planets.name: TOI-444 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-444 with a 18-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-444 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-444. Its orbit and size follow Oddo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
